title: MV Request volcano block material, not a volcano on a world map

posts.author: YSZH
posts.body:
Hello everyone, I am currently making a long Japanese RPG game, as shown in the picture. The game world view is large, and I hope to obtain volcano block resources. As shown in the picture, the original block of RPGmaker is not a perfect volcano. Although I have also learned some other blocks to draw volcanoes, it is not satisfactory. I hope to have a complete volcano, similar to Takahashi Celebrity Adventure Island. This style is the default style of RPGmaker MV, and other styles are also acceptable. The size is B block or less in the block settings, preferably 768X768. I have been looking for it since 2016, but I haven't found a suitable one. I hope there is a capable artist. Thank you very much for your help
大家好，我目前正在制作一款长篇日本 RPG 游戏，如图所示。游戏世界观大，希望获得火山块资源。如图所示，RPGmaker 的原始块并不是完美的火山。虽然我也学了一些其他的积木来画火山，但并不令人满意。我希望有一个完整的火山，类似于高桥名人冒险岛。该样式是 RPGmaker MV 的默认样式，其他样式也可以接受。大小为区块设置中的 B 块或以下，最好是 768X768。我从 2016 年开始一直在寻找它，但没有找到合适的。我希望有一位有能力的艺术家。非常感谢您的帮助

posts.body:

1. World Map image for a whole volcano (those DEFINITELY exist - I'll peek around and see if I can find the thread with it/them).
2. Parallax images to go into the background of your game to give the appearance of volcanoes.

1. 整个火山的世界地图图像（那些肯定存在 - 我会四处看看，看看我是否能找到它/它们的线索）。
2. 将视差图像放入游戏的背景中，以呈现火山的外观。

你是对的，但我的想法是在户外地图上添加一个火山块，类似于一些户外地图中的高楼大厦。这座火山也是独立的，世界地图中的火山太小了，无法使用。对于火山块，我希望它是一座更真实、更圆润的火山，而不是一座尖锐的方形块状火山。正如我在帖子中发送的那样，我目前有由其他块制成的火山，这感觉有点不合适。无论如何，首先感谢您的帮助
English translation: You're right, but my idea is to add a volcano block to the outdoor map, similar to the high-rise buildings in some outdoor maps. This volcano is also independent. The volcano on the world map is too small to be used. For the volcanic block, I hope it is a more real and rounder volcano, not a sharp square block volcano. As I sent in the post, I currently have volcanoes made of other blocks, which feels a little inappropriate. Anyway, first of all, thank you for your help.
